probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Previously presented) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Previously presented) Claim 3: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at least twenty-four inches on center.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Previously presented) Claim 8: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

(Previously presented) Claim 9: The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

(Previously presented) Claim 10: The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

(Previously presented) Claim 13: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall.

(Previously presented) Claim 14: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill.

(Previously presented) Claim 16: The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

(Cancelled) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: in a housing for mounting within a structure wall, a cooling system for evaporatively cooling an indoor area.

(Cancelled) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes placing the cooling system for evaporatively cooling between wall studs spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Cancelled) Claim 19: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes placing the cooling system for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

(Cancelled) Claim 20: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
